title: The amygdaloid complex: from morphology to neurodegeneration
title_zh: 杏仁核复合体：从形态学到神经退行性变
abstract: Abstract The amygdaloid complex is one of the most structurally and functionally heterogeneous regions of the mammalian brain, acting as an integrative node between sensory, mnemonic and visceral systems. It comprises a set of subnuclei whose cytoarchitectural differentiation, neurochemical profiles and anatomical boundaries have been debated since the earliest descriptions. This heterogeneity is established during ontogenetic development, assembling progenitors from pallial and subpallial domains, and preoptic and hypothalamic territories, resulting in a highly connected network. Maturation is not complete at birth, the amygdala changes through childhood and adolescence, leaving a protracted window of environmental sensitivity. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics have added a molecular layer to this framework, resolving populations that no single marker separates, and set explicit limits on the resolution at which rodent-derived subdivisions can be transferred to the human amygdala. Together these levels of description provide a structural framework for understanding its functions, which include emotional regulation and conditioned fear, social and sexual behaviours, decision-making, reward and punishment processing, empathy and memory modulation. Cross-species comparison reveals further variation, particularly the expansion of the basolateral complex in primates and the redistribution of neurons towards the lateral nucleus in humans. In summary, the amygdala acts as a densely connected hub with a broad role not only in physiological and psychological health but also in disease states; indeed, the amygdala is affected early in several neurodegenerative disorders, and in some (notably limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy and argyrophilic grain disease) it is among the first regions in which pathology is detected.
abstract_zh: 摘要：杏仁核复合体是哺乳动物大脑中结构和功能最为多样化的区域之一，充当感官、记忆和内脏系统之间的整合节点。它由一组亚核组成，其细胞结构差异、神经化学特征和解剖边界自最早描述以来就备受争议。这种异质性在胚胎发育过程中形成，来自苍白质和次苍白质、前视丘和下丘脑区域的前体细胞聚集，形成高度互联的网络。出生时尚未完全成熟，杏仁核在儿童期和青春期持续变化，留下一个延长的环境敏感窗口。单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组学为这一框架增添了分子层面，解析了单一标记无法区分的细胞群，并明确了将啮齿类动物亚分区转移到人类杏仁核时的分辨率限制。上述多层描述为理解其功能提供了结构框架，包括情绪调节、条件性恐惧、社会和性行为、决策、奖惩处理、共情和记忆调节。跨物种比较揭示了进一步的差异，尤其是灵长类动物基底外侧复合体的扩张以及人类神经元向外侧核的重新分布。总之，杏仁核作为一个高度互联的枢纽，在生理和心理健康以及疾病状态中发挥广泛作用；事实上，杏仁核在多种神经退行性疾病中早期受损，在某些疾病（尤其是边缘系统优先的年龄相关TDP-43脑病和银染颗粒病）中，它是最先检测到病理的区域之一。
